request.description: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful. Class: a mountain range for a square-grid strategy map, drawn as one raised terrain feature: one continuous ridge of connected rocky peaks that share a single rock mass, calmer and less saturated than units, thick single-colour black outline, simple shapes, no face and no eyes. It stands on the empty transparent background: nothing is drawn under it, no ground, no grass, no soil, no slab, no tile and no platform.
